name: ATK
fix_description: In getPrice, uses AMM spot price which can be manipulated via flash loan. Fix: use TWAP oracle or Chainlink price feed.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a very short flashswap-based price manipulation with essentially one core exploit action: borrow BUSDT, skew the ATK/BUSDT pair state, call the vulnerable reward claim, and repay. It relies on an obvious unsafe price dependency in getPrice() and requires only minimal multi-contract interaction and DeFi knowledge.
